description: Real-match reference sources for the v1.3 statistical realism benchmark. Raw third-party match files are fetched at runtime and are not vendored into this repository.

match_dataset.provider: datasets/football-datasets GitHub mirror of Football-Data.co.uk match statistics

premier_league_2024_25.note: Official Premier League comparison table reports 6m32s average second-half stoppage time and 8.4% of goals in 90+ during 2024/25.

premier_league_headers_2019_20_to_2023_2.note: Official Premier League season table reports headed shots and headed shots on target for five seasons: 2019/20 through 2023/24. This is supplemental validation only, not a core-index target.

methodology_notes: Core benchmark uses match-level fields whose definitions map directly to engine statistics.
xG, second-ball, goalkeeper-one-v-one, tactical-foul intent and other provider-dependent labels are excluded from the core index unless a like-for-like source is added.
The realism index is diagnostic only and must never be used as an in-match quota or target.
Continuous unfiltered engine seed ranges are used; the reserved official-final seed is rejected.

Card metrics are population-sensitive because benchmark teams are synthetic positional-template populations. Yellow/red gaps must be interpreted together with discipline-population diagnostics and must not, by themselves, trigger referee calibration.

Football-Data card fields are provider aggregates; second-yellow accounting can differ by competition/source convention, so yellow and red columns are not assumed to encode a universal dismissal taxonomy.

Body-part accuracy must be interpreted conditionally because headers and footed shots have very different location distributions. Aggregate header-vs-foot comparisons must not, by themselves, trigger finishing calibration.
